name: Unlock All Mystery Gifts
author: nickohlmeier
description: Makes every Mystery Gift ever distributed for Infinite Fusion redeemable again, not just the ones currently marked active on the official gift server.
The base game's Mystery Gift downloader ignores any gift the server has flagged 'enabled: false' - this is how past/expired event gifts (e.g. old Hoenn-release gifts) get retired over time.
This mod removes that check (region/version/trainer-ID gating still applies) so 'Search for public gifts' on the Continue/New Game screen offers all of them.
Purely additive - no existing files touched, no data structures changed.
